name: 45 degree hip extension glute focused
description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a rounded upper back. This shifts the focus onto the glutes.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench with your ankles locked.
Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze the glutes to raise back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
